signal-highlight.purpose: Headings, brand text, and high-priority navigation.

success-capture.purpose: Solved challenges and successful submissions only.

light-success-capture.purpose: Participant light-mode solved and successful states.

display.source: Bundled Raleway and RalewayOffline font faces.

body.purpose: Running text, forms, tables, navigation, and admin records.
body.source: Bundled Lato and LatoOffline font faces.

motion.name: orbital-drift
motion.value: Canvas sphere with randomized orbital speeds, phase drift, and twinkle
motion.purpose: Carry the supplied particle reference behind participant and admin content; the shared initializer draws a static frame for reduced motion and pauses while the document is hidden.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.value: 140–160ms ease; buttons press down 1px and challenge targets lift 2px
motion.purpose: Give direct, quick feedback on interactive controls.

narrative.overview:
This visual system frames a cybersecurity competition as an operations environment. Near-black surfaces, orbital-blue signals, and the animated particle field adapt the supplied reference to CTFd's challenge and scoreboard workflows. Raleway carries display headings; Lato keeps dense competition and administration content readable.

The participant theme and CTFd's separate admin theme share the dark palette, typography, and particle-field implementation. The participant theme also supports a light color mode; the admin theme currently uses the dark palette. Existing CTFd content, routes, and behavior remain the source of truth. The Halo inspiration informs atmosphere only; the system does not use Halo names, logos, characters, or game artwork.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black operational surfaces with pale orbital-blue actions and links.
A low-contrast canvas particle sphere animates behind page content.
Green is reserved for captured challenges and successful submissions.
Amber and red communicate warning and error states.
Participant and admin screens share the dark visual language; only participants have the documented light palette.

rules.name: The Capture State Rule
rules.body: Green means a successful submission or solved challenge; it is not a general accent.

rules.name: The Signal Contrast Rule
rules.body: Primary action text stays dark against the filled blue action; links and focus indicators use the brighter signal colors.

rules.name: The Two-Font Rule
rules.body: Use Raleway for headings and Lato for interface and running text; avoid adding another display face.

rules.name: The Quiet Orbit Rule
rules.body: The particle field stays behind content, never captures pointer input, and never animates for users who request reduced motion.

dos: Do use orbital blue for actions, links, active controls, and focus.
Do reserve green for captured or successful states.
Do keep the particle field quiet behind dense challenge and admin content.
Do preserve CTFd's translated strings, routes, plugin slots, and keyboard behaviors.
Do keep participant light mode consistent with its remapped blue-gray token roles.
donts: Don't place the particle field at full opacity beneath text-heavy content.
Don't use Halo names, logos, characters, or game artwork as theme assets.
Don't use warning amber or error red as general decoration.
Don't replace established CTFd terminology with invented operational labels.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Filled blue action with dark text and quick press feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.65rem; padding: .55rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #87b6eb; border-radius: .4rem; background: #87b6eb; color: #07111c; font: 700 1rem Lato, sans-serif; transition: transform 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #b5d5f7; background: #b5d5f7; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #93bdf1; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Outlined action for a secondary task.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 2.65rem; padding: .55rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #93bdf1; border-radius: .4rem; background: transparent; color: #c2ddff; font: 700 1rem Lato, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(124, 174, 230, .16); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #93bdf1; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Operations Panel
components.description: Graphite container for challenge and competition content.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(142, 177, 214, .2); border-radius: .55rem; background: #111b27; color: #d9e6f4; font: 400 1rem/1.55 Lato, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 .5rem; color: #e4effc; font: 600 1.3rem/1.15 Raleway, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Challenge Target
components.description: Interactive challenge target; solved state switches to capture green.
components.css: .ds-challenge { display: flex; min-height: 8rem; width: 100%; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid #30465e; border-radius: .55rem; background: #0f1823; color: #d9e6f4; text-align: left; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-challenge:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: #93bdf1; background: #172434; } .ds-challenge:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #93bdf1; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-challenge span { color: #93bdf1; } .ds-challenge.is-solved { border-color: rgba(102, 217, 166, .75); background: rgba(19, 54, 45, .9); color: #d4f7e6; } .ds-challenge.is-solved span { color: #66d9a6; }

components.name: Dark Field Input
components.description: Inset form field with visible orbital-blue focus feedback.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: .5rem; color: #d9e6f4; font: 700 .9rem Lato, sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height: 2.65rem; padding: .55rem .75rem; border: 1px solid #34485e; border-radius: .4rem; background: #0a1119; color: #e2edf9; font: 400 1rem Lato, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a2b2c5; opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #93bdf1; box-shadow: 0 0 0 .2rem rgba(120, 171, 227, .18); outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #93bdf1; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Fixed Navigation
components.description: Near-black fixed navigation with a signal-highlight active link.
components.html: Cyber FestChallengesScoreboard
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 4.25rem; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(142, 177, 214, .2); background: #080c12; color: #c2d0df; font: 400 .9rem Lato, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { margin-right: auto; color: #c2ddff; font: 700 1rem Raleway, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .075em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-link { color: #c2d0df; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: #c2ddff; } .ds-brand:focus-visible, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #93bdf1; outline-offset: 3px; }
